"import cadquery as cq

# Base plate with central boss and bolt holes — all dimensions hard-coded (mm)
L = 110.0        # plate length along X
W = 70.0         # plate width along Y
T = 12.0         # plate thickness along Z (base at z=0)
BOSS_D = 40.0    # boss diameter
BOSS_H = 25.0    # boss height above plate top (boss top at z=37)
HOLE_D = 9.0     # through-hole diameter
HX = 41.0        # hole X offsets (+/-)
HY = 21.0        # hole Y offsets (+/-)

# Reliable sequence: plate -> boss on top face -> four through holes last
part = (cq.Workplane("XY").rect(L, W).extrude(T)                 # base plate
        .faces(">Z").workplane().circle(BOSS_D / 2.0).extrude(BOSS_H)  # central boss
        .faces(">Z").workplane()                                  # topmost face (boss top)
        .pushPoints([(-HX, -HY),
                     (HX, -HY),
                     (-HX, HY),
                     (HX, HY)])
        .circle(HOLE_D / 2.0).cutThruAll())                       # 4 bolt holes, plate only

solid = part.val()  # single Solid
cq.exporters.export(solid, "part.step")"
